instruction: Decide which tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD is suitable for the task. Launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to perform a modal analysis of a cantilever beam (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Model Definition: Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 12 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane and extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 420 mm. This produces a beam with cross-section 12 mm x 10 mm and length 420 mm. Material and Section: Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, and density = 7.80e-9 tonne/mm^3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to the entire beam. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the beam. Analysis Step: Create a Linear Perturbation Frequency step named Step-Modal-A. Request 4 eigenvalues. Loads and Boundary Conditions: Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the fixed end face at X = 0. Discretization: Mesh the beam with a global seed size of 12 mm. Assign the element type appropriate three-dimensional solid element formulation and generate the mesh. Job Execution: Create a job named Job-Modal-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Post-Processing: Review the first four mode shapes. Record the first natural frequency in Hz. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
